title: General settings
description: Tax identity, logo, billing and opening hours for your restaurant.
description_for: General data for {{name}}: identity, logo, billing and hours.

demo_locked.title: Read-only demo restaurant
demo_locked.description: You can review the settings, but you cannot save changes or replace the logo.

identidad.title: Tax identity
identidad.description: RUC, legal name and address shown on electronic receipts issued by the restaurant.

branding.title: Visual identity
branding.description: The logo appears on this tenant’s login and in the restaurant sidebar.

facturacion.title: Billing and SUNAT receipts
facturacion.description: Currency, VAT and whether this restaurant will issue electronic boletas or invoices (according to your plan).

horarios.title: Opening hours
horarios.description: Days and hours the restaurant is open. Used later for delivery, reservations and customer notices.

fields.nombre_comercial_hint: Public-facing restaurant name. If empty, the legal name is used.
fields.logo_hint: Upload a square image (PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG) up to 2 MB. Transparent background works best.
fields.logo_hint_uploaded: Logo saved. Replace it by uploading another image or remove it with the button.
fields.logo_drop: Drop your logo here or click to choose a file
fields.logo_drop_supported: PNG · JPG · WEBP · SVG · 2 MB max
fields.igv_afectacion_hint: How this restaurant issues electronic receipts. Taxed = code 10; Exempt = 20; Unaffected = 30.
fields.igv_porcentaje_hint: Standard Peruvian rate: 18%. Applies to sodas, water, beer and packaged goods.
fields.igv_alimentos_porcentaje_hint: Default 18%. The 10% restaurant rate (Law 31556) is no longer in force; change this only if your accountant still uses another rate.
fields.igv_restaurante_note: In Peru the general IGV is 18%. Restaurant meals and drinks are currently taxed at 18%. Packaged sodas, water and similar products are also 18%. If your books use a different rate for dishes, set it under «Prepared-food IGV» without changing the 18% for drinks.
fields.precio_incluye_igv_hint: If on, the system derives the taxable base from the final price. If off, IGV is added on top.
fields.ticket_ancho_mm_hint: 56, 57 and 58 mm are narrow rolls. 80 mm is the wide roll (the printer uses a ~72 mm head; that is not a choice).
fields.emite_comprobantes_sunat_hint: Turn off if you only use the software for tables, kitchen and inventory without billing the customer. You can still keep currency and IGV for internal tickets.
fields.apisunat_tenant_hint: FoodSaaS support manages this credential for security. Contact us if you need to enable or replace it.
fields.apisunat_superadmin_hint: Set the APISUNAT (Lucode) token so this restaurant can issue electronic receipts.
fields.apisunat_mode_sandbox_hint: Sandbox sends to Lucode test. CPEs are not valid before SUNAT.
fields.apisunat_mode_produccion_hint: This only picks the Lucode production URL. Real boletas/invoices require that company in apisunat.com to have completed “Go to production” (certificate, secondary user and GRE). If Lucode is still in development you will see an authorization error even with a token configured here.
fields.apisunat_token_replace: New token (leave empty to keep the current one)
fields.apisunat_token_hint: Token of that same company in Lucode. Production: app.apisunat.pe. Sandbox: the development token. Do not mix a test token with Production mode.

footer.never_updated: No settings have been saved yet.

plan_sin_facturacion_electronica.title: Your plan does not include SUNAT e-invoicing
plan_sin_facturacion_electronica.body: You can keep using the system as usual. To issue receipts, the platform admin must assign a plan with electronic boletas or invoices.
